top_signals.title: 5 LNG Megaprojects Poised to Power the Next Gas Boom
top_signals.summary: The war between the US and Iran has driven up natural gas prices, particularly in Europe and Asia. Asia accounts for nearly 90% of liquefied natural gas (LNG) shipments from key Middle East producers like Qatar and the UAE, while Europe imports 7-11% of its LNG from the region. During spring 2026 missile and drone attacks, Iranian strikes hit Ras Laffan LNG Trains 4 & 6, and Pearl GTL Train 2. Ras Laffan owner QatarEnergy estimates repairs to the two units will sideline about 12.8 million tonnes per year of LNG capacity for three to five years.…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Gold Advances After Tame US Inflation Data Eases Rate-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: Gold advanced to a two-month high after a subdued US inflation report relieved near-term pressure on the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Boeing unveils cheap radar seeker built from off-the-shelf parts
top_signals.summary: Seekers are among the most expensive parts of a guided weapon, and Boeing’s argument is that their cost is what limits how many the military can buy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: China Revives Free-Trade-Zone Bond Market After Crackdown
top_signals.summary: The Shanghai free-trade zone’s bond market had its first pricing by a nonfinancial firm since Chinese authorities clamped down on excessive borrowing by local governments in late 2023.

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
